title: Cranberries
body:
"Cranberries are tart, red berries often used in sauces, juices, and baked goods."

Description

Cranberries is a item that can be found on Bushes in the Forest area, heading to the Beachlands/Acidlands.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $100 per Cranberries. In its jam form it may be sold for $400.

Gives a brief fire resistance boost when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.18% per bunch of cranberries.
